critical_code_review_comments: _generate_daily_coupon uses atomic CAS on settings.auto_coupon_last_generated_date — good idempotency guard against concurrent workers.
POST /api/withdrawals returns HTTP 423 with the admin-defined message (matches spec — client can distinguish from other 4xx).
GET /api/coupons/daily correctly computes next_drop_at in UTC ISO for client countdown; server-side time uses Africa/Lagos throughout.
Coupon code alphabet excludes 0/O/1/I/L for readability (regex /^LUCKY-[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{4}$/ verified).
Cron sleeps 45s at startup then ticks every 30s — worst-case delay ~30s from configured drop time.
